name: By a Thread
label: Revelation
lede: Two guitarists from the Vancouver hardcore band Strain slowed down in 1996, pressed one white-vinyl LP on Revelation in 1999, and have kept coming back to By a Thread ever since.

eras.title: Strain goes soft-spoken
eras.text: Two members of the Vancouver hardcore band Strain started By a Thread in 1996. The songs got slower and more melodic, and the lyrics kept the hardcore habit of talking about society and who you answer to.

years.h: Two Strain guitarists start By a Thread in Vancouver
years.p: John Franco and Sean Lande, both ex-Strain, add bassist Steven Fairweather and drummer Joe Franco. Franco sings and plays guitar; Lande plays guitar.

years.h: Sunny Day Real Estate and Sparkmarker set the bearings
years.p: Revelation's bio names Seattle's [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]] and Vancouver's [[Sparkmarker|f3f3410d-e096-438e-be37-905009125da4]] as By a Thread's touchstones.
years.xp: The lyrics carried over from the members' hardcore bands: society, tradition and personal independence, in Revelation's wording.

q: My lyrics come from life experiences.
years.src: Revelation Records · Revelation Records: pressing history
years.h: Last of the Daydreams comes out in a run of 226
years.p: Ten songs, opening with Surface, on REV 82. Revelation pressed the vinyl once, on white.
years.xp:
Revelation's bio let John Franco explain where the words came from: "My lyrics come from life experiences. I try to remain true to the feelings of the moment."

A 2001 PUNKNEWS.org review, quoted in the bio, put the band next to Thursday and Jimmy Eat World and called it "destined for big things." The clips here are the 7" versions of Surface and Castle, from 1998.

eras.title: One more record, then quiet
eras.text: Twelve years after the LP, By a Thread put out a self-titled 12" on Revelation. Then nothing for a long stretch.

years.src: Revelation Records: pressing history · No Echo
years.h: A self-titled 12" arrives on Revelation, REV 148
years.p: Pressed in 330 copies on gray and 219 on black. By a Thread go quiet again afterward.

eras.title: Mirrored Life
eras.text: Sean Lande and John Franco rebuilt the band with Gabe Mantle of Gob on drums and Carl McBeath on bass, then took about two years over an album shaped by grief.

years.h: Fourteen years on, Mirrored Life arrives on Spartan
years.p: Gabe Mantle of [[Gob|c6903a2e-063c-4f91-a284-17b8f421be7b]] plays drums and Carl McBeath bass. Lande says loss and grief shaped the songs.
years.xp:
Drums and bass went down at a larger studio, guitars at engineer Stu's home, vocals with a friend, Cheyne. John Franco mixed it and added parts at home.

"This time, we had the luxury and curse of doing things on our own time," Lande told No Echo.

years.h: First show back is set for October 10
years.p: By a Thread return to the stage that night. Lande says European dates are in the works and a next album is the plan after that.
